# Daily stand-up — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens to a short, usually round-robin status exchange about recent
work, current intent, and blockers.

## What to extract

- Record Did, Doing, and Blockers per person when the conversation supports it.
- Classify blockers as internal, cross-team, or external and link the blocking
  item when known.
- Summarise sprint health: unplanned work, forgotten items, and WIP pressure.

## Missing topics worth noting

Note blockers without owners, work nobody can connect to the board, and people
whose update is genuinely absent. Do not require a rigid three-question format.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not treat a status statement as a commitment or evaluate individual
performance from brevity, tone, or missing detail.
